search.snippet: The spotted kebbit is a kebbit that players can capture with the Hunter skill using falconry at level 43 or above, granting 104 Hunter experience. They can be found exclusively in the Piscatoris falconry area. Spotted kebbits may be assigned as a hunters' rumour task by Guild Hunters Gilman, Cervus, or Ornus. They drop spotted kebbit fur when caught, which can be used to make the spotted cape.
